supersedes: vector set v1 (v1 signatures were not low-S; v1 is replaced, not patched)
note: CONFORMANCE VECTOR. Synthetic data and throwaway keys: nothing here is a real customer, scan, key or credential. Do not treat any key in this file as an Agent Verify signing key.

formulas.signingInput: UTF8("agentverify-attestation/profile-assessment/v1\n") || UTF8(JCS(payload)), JCS under the signed-content numeric profile
formulas.signature: base64( ECDSA-P256-SHA256( privateKey, signingInput ) ), raw r||s (64 bytes), standard base64 with padding, LOW-S (s <= floor(n/2)): an Agent Verify canonical-signature rule, not an RFC 7518 requirement
formulas.keyId: base64url( SHA-256( JCS({ crv, kty, x, y }) ) )  (RFC 7638); x and y must be canonical unpadded base64url of exactly 32 bytes
formulas.bundleVersion: NOT part of the signing input or any digest: the outer bundle is unsigned framing in v1
